verdict.rationale: JMAP's design (single HTTP request with a `methodCalls` array for query/fetch/send, fastmail-docs-38) inherently supports batching many operations together, and filters/rules (fastmail-docs-6) allow rule-based bulk processing of mail. However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk-update/bulk-delete API pattern, no example of bulk operations across large item sets, and no independent evidence of this being used for AI-native bulk workflows. Missing for 10: explicit bulk operation API examples (e.g., bulk delete/move across many message IDs), documented limits/performance for large batches, and independent confirmation of successful bulk automation use.
